steps.input:
ti=G['Test input']
top=ti[:8]; bot=ti[9:]
T=[[1 if c==8 else 0 for c in r] for r in top]
B=[[1 if c==8 else 0 for c in r] for r in bot]
print('TOP:')
for r in T: print(''.join('#' if x else '.' for x in r))
print('BOT:')
for r in B: print(''.join('#' if x else '.' for x in r))
print('AND:',sum(a&b for ra,rb in zip(T,B) for a,b in zip(ra,rb)))
print('XOR:',sum(a^b for ra,rb in zip(T,B) for a,b in zip(ra,rb)))
print('OR:',sum(a|b for ra,rb in zip(T,B) for a,b in zip(ra,rb)))
# best shift overlap
best=[]
for dr in range(-7,8):
    for dc in range(-14,15):
        s=0
        for r in range(8):
            for c in range(15):
                r2,c2=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=r2<8 and 0<=c2<15:
                    s+=T[r][c]&B[r2][c2]
        best.append((s,dr,dc))
best.sort(reverse=True)
print('best shifts:',best[:8])
